title: Yummy Crispy Chinese Cod Soup
description: A comforting, slightly spicy soup featuring tender cod fillets crisped in a soy‑garlic broth, finished with fresh cilantro and a splash of sesame oil.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine vegetable stock, soy sauce, oyster sauce, shaoxing wine, garlic, ginger, and fresh chili; bring to a simmer over medium heat.
While the broth simmers, pat the cod fillets dry and coat them lightly with cornstarch.
When the broth is simmering, gently slide the coated cod fillets into the pot, covering them completely; cook for 3 to 4 minutes until the fillets turn opaque.
Reduce the heat to low, add shredded cabbage, and let the soup steam for an additional 2 minutes until the cabbage is tender but still crisp.
Remove the cod fillets with a slotted spoon and set them aside on a plate.
Strain the broth to remove solids, then return the clear liquid to the saucepan and bring back to a gentle simmer.
Season the broth with salt to taste and stir in the sesame oil.
Return the cod fillets to the pot and warm them through for 1 minute; the fillets should remain crispy on the surface.
Ladle the soup into bowls, garnish each with sliced scallions and a sprinkle of fresh cilantro if you like.
Serve hot, accompanied by steamed jasmine rice if you like.
